title: YOUR PASSWORD IS YOUR NAME
caption: Your password is your name. Fix it. #CyberSecurity #InfoSec #DataBreach #Privacy #EthicalHacking

beats.copy:
Most people use their own name
as their password.

That means a stranger
can guess it in one try.

The breach report showed
34% reused the same word.

One password manager
fixes every account.

Your name should never
be your password.
